CA Superior Court County of Yuba Richard a Schoenig Annex

The CA Superior Court County of Yuba Richard a Schoenig Annex serves the citizens of Yuba County, California. This court handles a variety of legal matters including civil, criminal, domestic relations, juvenile, mental health, and probate cases. The courthouse is located in Marysville and provides essential services for the local community.

Overview of the CA Superior Court County of Yuba Richard a Schoenig Annex

Location and Contact Information

The CA Superior Court County of Yuba Richard a Schoenig Annex is located at 120 Fifith Street in Marysville, CA 95901.

The court can be contacted by phone at 530-749-7685

email at clerk@co.yuba.ca.us.

Additional information can be found on the court's website at http://www.yubacourts.org/.

Court System Type and Divisions

This courthouse handles the following case types:

  • Civil
  • Criminal
  • Domestic Relations
  • Juvenile
  • Mental Health
  • Probate

County Clerk, Judges, and Staff

The CA Superior Court County of Yuba Richard a Schoenig Annex employs the following staff:

  • Dennis J. Buckley, Judge
  • James L. Curry, Judge
  • Debra L. Givens, Judge
  • Kathleen R. O'Connor, Judge
  • Julia L. Scrogin, Judge

Court Services and Functions

General Jury Duty Information

The CA Superior Court County of Yuba Richard a Schoenig Annex summons jurors when needed for trials. Citizens can find information about jury duty requirements and procedures on the court's website.

Court Records, Ticket Payments, and Other Information

Individuals can visit the courthouse in person to make ticket payments, access court records, and get information about various services. The court's website also provides helpful information and instructions for accessing records, making payments, filing documents, and more.

Employment Listings and US Government Holiday Closings

The court may close for certain US federal holidays. Check the court's website for updated closures and holidays. The website also offers employment opportunities for court positions and related legal roles.

Nearby Courts

Conclusion

In summary, the CA Superior Court County of Yuba Richard a Schoenig Annex provides critical court services and access to justice for the residents of Yuba County. The courthouse handles civil, criminal, family, juvenile, mental health, and probate legal matters. Citizens can visit the court's website or contact the office directly for more information on services, records, payments, employment opportunities, and nearby court locations.

FAQs

Q: What are the court's hours of operation?

A: The CA Superior Court County of Yuba Richard a Schoenig Annex is open Monday through Friday from 8:00am to 5:00pm, excluding holidays. Check the court's website for updated hours and closures.

Q: How can I get a copy of a record from this court?

A: You can request copies of records by visiting the courthouse in person, mailing in a records request, or accessing records online through the court's website if available. Follow the instructions on the website for requesting records. There may be fees associated with copying and mailing records.

Q: What do I do if I receive a jury summons from this court?

A: If you receive a jury duty summons you are required to report for service on the date listed. Follow all instructions on the summons and contact the court with any questions. You may be able to reschedule your service if needed by following the court's procedures.

Q: Can I pay a ticket issued in Yuba County at this courthouse?

A: Yes, you can pay traffic tickets and fines in person at the clerk's office in this courthouse. You may also be able to pay tickets online or by mail. Check with the court for accepted payment methods.

Q: How can I get married at the Yuba County Courthouse?

A: Visit the court's website for information on getting a marriage license from the Yuba County Clerk. You can have a civil marriage ceremony performed at the courthouse after obtaining your marriage license. Contact the court for details on scheduling a civil ceremony.
